summary: x = the components of ν at P; it is a unit since ν·ν̄ = 1, ≡ 1 off w, and both sides agree at P.

steps.claim: Take x = evalPlaces_P(ν), integral because ν is; it is a unit with inverse evalPlaces_P(ν̄) (integral as well) because ν·ν̄ = 1.
steps.lean:
⟨.mkOfMulEqOne ⟨_, evalPlaces_mem_O _ a.1⟩ ⟨_,
  evalPlaces_mem_O _ (star_mem_Ô a.1)⟩ congr(⟨evalPlaces P $(ν.2.2), _⟩),

steps.claim: For v ∈ P with v ≠ w: ν_v = 1 by a (v ≠ w, and v̄ ≠ w since P is disjoint from P̄), so reduction(x)_v = 1.
steps.lean:
fun v e ↦
  (residueEquiv v).map_eq_one_iff.2 congr(.mk _ ⟨$(a.2 v (by grind) (by grind [star_notMem])), _⟩),

steps.claim: embedGL(inclGL(x·1)) = scalarFin(n, ν): both lie in supportedOn(n, P) (for ν by a) and have the same components at the places of P.
steps.lean:
